title: 配水系統分區計量
summary: 本課從控制體與雙向邊界開始，逐步建立可追溯的分區水量帳，分析水表偏差、時間積分、夜間合法用水、壓力正規化及水池儲量。最後將遙測缺值和不確定度納入改善成效評估，使學徒能分辨真正漏失、資料錯置與用水改變，而不只讀取單一水損百分比。
summaryEn: Beginning with control volumes and bidirectional boundaries, this course builds a traceable district balance through meter bias, time integration, legitimate night use, pressure normalization and tank storage. It then incorporates telemetry gaps and uncertainty into intervention assessment, distinguishing actual leakage from data misalignment and demand change rather than relying on one loss percentage.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創敏感度例採日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³及儲量增加50 m³，殘差為50 m³。僅假設入口表多記1%，其他項目固定，記錄入口變成1010 m³，殘差增為60 m³，表計1%的偏差造成殘差20%的變化。這不是漏水真的增加，而是大體積相減的敏感性。應先確認表計、時間窗與邊界，再用壓力匹配的夜流及獨立調查驗證。若多項誤差相關，不能直接用平方和縮小不確定度；本例也不把殘差全部分類為實漏。
workedExample.textEn: An original sensitivity example uses daily inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³, leaving 50 m³. If only the inlet meter over-registers by 1%, recorded inflow becomes 1010 m³ and the residual rises to 60 m³: a 1% meter bias changes the residual by 20%. Physical leakage has not increased; the effect comes from subtracting large quantities. Verify metering, windows and boundaries before checking pressure-matched night flow and independent investigation. Correlated errors cannot automatically be reduced through a root-sum-square calculation, and the example does not classify the entire residual as real leakage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」與「邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification" and "Boundary valves and bidirectional flow mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區水量平衡邊界」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “District water-balance boundary” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分區計量先定義哪些入口、出口、用戶與儲水設施包含在同一控制體，才有可比較的水量帳。入口水量減去出口、合法用水與儲量變化後形成殘差，但殘差仍可能混合實漏、漏計用水及表計誤差；因此水量不平衡是調查線索，不能直接等同地下管線破口流量。本例的出口為輸出到其他區域的水量，儲量增加取正；所有項目必須涵蓋相同時間窗，且不能重複扣除已包含的用水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區水量平衡邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: District metering begins by defining which inlets, outlets, customers and storage assets belong to one control volume. Inflow minus exports, authorized use and storage change produces a residual, but that residual can combine real leakage, unrecorded use and meter errors. Water imbalance is therefore an investigation signal rather than a direct measure of underground opening discharge. Exports leave the district and storage increase is positive in this example. Every term must cover the same time window, without double-counting consumption already included elsewhere. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “District water-balance boundary” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³、儲量增加50 m³，殘差R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one-day inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區水量平衡邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “District water-balance boundary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification

quiz.question: 關於「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。

steps.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分區水量平衡邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “District water-balance boundary” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³、儲量增加50 m³，殘差R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one-day inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³. Residual R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一核對邊界閥、計量點及區內水池，把圖面連通狀態與現場標識對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check boundary valves, meters and internal tanks individually, matching mapped connectivity with field identification.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要流量曲線看起來平順，任何積分方式都會得到相同水量。
漏失壓力指數可以直接套在所有用戶需求與總入口流量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一日入口1000 m³、跨區出口100 m³、合法用水800 m³、儲量增加50 m³，殘差R=1000−100−800−50=50 m³。

A leakage pressure exponent applies directly to all customer demand and inlet flow.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one-day inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one-day inflow 1000 m³, exports 100 m³, authorized use 800 m³ and storage increase 50 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區水量平衡邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “District water-balance boundary” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐一核對邊界閥、計量點及區內水池，把圖面連通狀態與現場標識對照。將水量來源、時間窗與儲量算法寫入資料字典，再以獨立流量紀錄查驗殘差是否只是分類或時間錯置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check boundary valves, meters and internal tanks individually, matching mapped connectivity with field identification. Record data sources, time windows and storage calculations in a dictionary, then use independent flow records to determine whether residuals reflect classification or timing errors. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為一個含水池與跨區出口的假設分區畫控制體，標示每筆水量進出方向。再列出殘差可能的三種來源，指定能區分實漏、漏計與儀表偏差的證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a control volume for a district containing storage and an export, marking every flow direction. List three possible residual sources and identify evidence separating real leakage, unrecorded use and instrument bias.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏列一條跨區供水管會把正常輸水算成漏失，重複扣除用戶水量又會產生不合理負殘差；如果直接據此部署測漏，調查可能始終找不到對應漏點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting an export main classifies legitimate transfer as loss, while subtracting customer use twice can create an implausible negative residual. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification"?
options: 逐一核對邊界閥、計量點及區內水池，把圖面連通狀態與現場標識對照。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
入口流量穩定時就可以把區內所有水池儲量變化忽略。
optionsEn: Check boundary valves, meters and internal tanks individually, matching mapped connectivity with field identification.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Stable inlet flow allows all internal tank-storage changes to be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 逐一核對邊界閥、計量點及區內水池，把圖面連通狀態與現場標識對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check boundary valves, meters and internal tanks individually, matching mapped connectivity with field identification. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區水量平衡邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “District water-balance boundary” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏列一條跨區供水管會把正常輸水算成漏失，重複扣除用戶水量又會產生不合理負殘差；如果直接據此部署測漏，調查可能始終找不到對應漏點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting an export main classifies legitimate transfer as loss, while subtracting customer use twice can create an implausible negative residual. Leak surveys based directly on these mistakes may never find a corresponding defect. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例的出口為輸出到其他區域的水量，儲量增加取正；所有項目必須涵蓋相同時間窗，且不能重複扣除已包含的用水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every term must cover the same time window, without double-counting consumption already included elsewhere.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區水量平衡邊界機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "District water-balance boundary mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

steps.title: 邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「邊界閥與雙向流量」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Boundary valves and bidirectional flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分區管網不必只有單一入口，尖峰需求、泵切換或相鄰水位變化都可能讓邊界管反向流動。水量帳應保留流向符號與實際連通狀態，否則同一支流量計的負值可能被誤刪為異常；邊界閥名義關閉也不等於完全隔離，內漏會讓控制體的假設失效。本式只對同一時刻的有號流量加總，不能拿它代替整日積分；感測器正方向與管網圖的正方向須事先一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊界閥與雙向流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A district need not have a single inlet. Peak demand, pump switching and neighboring levels can reverse flow through boundary pipes. The balance must retain direction signs and actual connectivity, or negative meter values may be discarded as anomalies. A nominally closed valve also does not prove isolation: internal leakage can invalidate the assumed control volume. This expression sums signed flows at one instant and does not replace daily integration. Sensor-positive direction must be made consistent with the network map beforehand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Boundary valves and bidirectional flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三條邊界管向內為正，Q1=32 L/s、Q2=18 L/s、Q3=−7 L/s，淨入口Qnet=43 L/s。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分區入口表出現負值就一定是儀器故障而應刪除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊界閥與雙向流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Boundary valves and bidirectional flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三條邊界管向內為正，Q1=32 L/s、Q2=18 L/s、Q3=−7 L/s，淨入口Qnet=43 L/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inward flow is positive on three boundaries: Q1=32 L/s, Q2=18 L/s and Q3=−7 L/s. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 邊界閥與雙向流量機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「邊界閥與雙向流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以已核准的正常供水狀態比較流量方向與兩側壓力，核對資料庫是否保存負值。巡查邊界閥狀態並使用適當獨立證據確認隔離，將每次拓樸改變連到計量分析的時間範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare flow direction with pressure on both sides during approved normal supply conditions, checking that the database preserves negative values. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification" and "Flow integration and sampling windows mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 表計系統偏差與低流量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Meter bias and low-flow behavior mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「表計系統偏差與低流量」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Meter bias and low-flow behavior” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大流量入口表與分散用戶表具有不同量程和使用條件，小百分比系統偏差乘上大基數後可能接近真正水損。低流量、安裝直管段不足、氣泡或老化會影響量測，廠商名目精度不保證所有現場流況；應把校準、安裝與資料處理視為完整計量鏈。誤差百分比的分母在此定義為真實體積，負偏差表示少記；不能把量程百分比與讀值百分比混為同一種精度規格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「表計系統偏差與低流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A bulk inlet meter and distributed customer meters operate over different ranges and conditions. A small systematic percentage applied to a large volume can approach the true loss. stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Time alignment across meters mechanism and verification" and "Tank storage and level-area relations mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多水表時間對齊機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Time alignment across meters mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多水表時間對齊」如何影響配水系統分區計量的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time alignment across meters” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “District-metered water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分區入口與用戶水表即使都精確，若統計起訖時間不同，仍會產生假的水量殘差。尖峰時段的幾分鐘錯位可能比低需求時更顯著，時區、夏令時間及累積計數重設也會改變每日邊界；時間對齊應在資料彙總之前完成，不能靠事後調整漏失比例補救。算例只估固定流量下的時間窗差異體積，變動流量須對缺少或多出的時間段積分；它不是水表本身的流量誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多水表時間對齊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Accurate inlet and customer meters can still produce false residuals when their reporting windows differ. A few minutes of mismatch near a demand peak can matter more than during quiet periods, and time zones, daylight-saving transitions and totalizer resets alter daily boundaries. Align timestamps before aggregation instead of correcting the resulting error with an arbitrary leakage factor. The example estimates window-mismatch volume at constant flow. Variable flow requires integration over the missing or extra interval, and this is not intrinsic meter-flow error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Time alignment across meters” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設統計窗錯開Δt=5 min、該段流量Q=0.20 m³/min，假殘差ΔV=QΔt=1.0 m³，並無實際漏水增加。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水表都經過校準就不需要核對它們的統計時間窗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設統計窗錯開Δt=5 min、該段流量Q=0.20 m³/min，假殘差ΔV=QΔt=1.0 m³，並無實際漏水增加。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
